environment.description: Go 1.21 microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. The service listens on port 8080, ELB forwards TCP on port 80 directly. No reverse proxy, no response header injection middleware. Admin endpoint is protected only by the X-Admin-Token header check in application code. The service runs as a single binary with GOMAXPROCS=4.

config.infrastructure: EC2 t3.medium, classic ELB TCP passthrough
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 80
